examples.english: I broke out in a night sweat.

examples.japanese: {夏|なつ}は{寝汗|ねあせ}がひどい。
examples.english: Night sweats are bad in summer.

examples.japanese: {寝汗|ねあせ}で{目|め}が{覚|さ}めてパジャマを{着替|きが}えた。
examples.english: I woke up from night sweats and changed my pajamas.

notes:
{寝汗|ねあせ} is a compound of {寝|ね} (sleep) + {汗|あせ} (sweat). It refers to perspiration that occurs while sleeping.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {寝汗|ねあせ}をかく: to have night sweats
- {寝汗|ねあせ}がひどい: to have bad night sweats
- {寝汗|ねあせ}で{目|め}が{覚|さ}める: to wake up from night sweats
- {寝汗|ねあせ}{対策|たいさく}: measures against night sweats

CAUSES:
Can be caused by hot weather, illness, fever, stress, or medications. Persistent night sweats may indicate a medical condition and are worth consulting a doctor about.

RELATED TYPES OF SWEAT:
- {汗|あせ}: sweat (general)
- {冷|ひ}や{汗|あせ}: cold sweat (from fear or nervousness)
- {脂汗|あぶらあせ}: greasy sweat (from pain or anxiety)
- {手|て}{汗|あせ}: sweaty palms
